papers.title: A rare germline TXNIP missense mutation may contribute to the genesis of familial ovarian mature teratoma in human.
papers.title_ja: 家族性卵巣成熟奇形腫の発症に関与する可能性のある稀な生殖系列TXNIPミスセンス変異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
papers.summary_ja: 反復・多発性の家族性卵巣成熟奇形腫の家系で全エクソーム解析を行い、生殖系列TXNIPミスセンス変異(p.Pro350Leu)を同定した。変異型TXNIPは蓄積が少なく分解が速く、K48型ユビキチン化が増強していた。家族性腫瘍ではTXNIP染色が弱くGLUT1染色が強かった。TXNIP欠損はGLUT1の細胞膜移行、糖取り込み、PI3K/mTOR経路の活性化を促し、感受性遺伝子の候補と考えられた。
papers.summary_en: Whole-exome sequencing in a family with recurrent multifocal ovarian mature teratoma identified a rare germline TXNIP missense variant, p.Pro350Leu. The variant showed lower protein abundance, faster decay, and greater K48-linked polyubiquitination. Familial tumors had weaker TXNIP and stronger GLUT1 staining than sporadic ones. TXNIP depletion increased GLUT1 membrane localization, glucose uptake, lactate production, and PI3K/mTOR signaling, suggesting TXNIP as a candidate susceptibility gene.

papers.title: A rare case report of an endobronchial teratoma of the right upper lobe invading the mediastinum.
papers.title_ja: 縦隔浸潤を伴う右上葉気管支内奇形腫の稀な症例報告
papers.summary_ja: 縦隔に浸潤した右上葉気管支内奇形腫の稀な症例報告。
papers.summary_en: Case report of a rare endobronchial teratoma of the right upper lobe invading the mediastinum, treated with en bloc thymectomy and lobectomy.

papers.title: Anti-N-methyl-D-Aspartate Receptor Autoimmune Encephalitis Due to Ovarian Teratoma in a 17-Year-Old Young Woman: Case Report and Review of the Literature.
papers.title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫による抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した17歳女性の症例報告と文献レビュー
papers.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫による抗NMDA受容体自己免疫性脳炎を発症した17歳女性の症例報告と文献レビュー。
papers.summary_en: Case report and literature review of anti-NMDA receptor autoimmune encephalitis due to ovarian teratoma in a 17-year-old woman.

papers.title: Detection of germ cell neoplasia in situ and testicular cancer risk in men with testicular microlithiasis: Real world results through 10 years.
papers.title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を有する男性における胚細胞腫瘍in situ病変の検出と精巣がんリスク：10年間の実臨床成績
papers.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化の男性334例を後方視的に検討した研究です。生検を受けた137例中10例（7.3%）で胚細胞腫瘍in situ病変が見つかり、いずれも精巣萎縮を伴っていました。中央値4.7年の追跡で精巣がんは3例（0.9%）に発生しました。精巣萎縮がある場合にのみ生検を考慮すべきと結論されています。
papers.summary_en: A retrospective review of 334 men diagnosed with testicular microlithiasis at a tertiary center from 2013 to 2023. Among 137 men who underwent biopsy, germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) was found in 10 (7.3%), all in testes with both microlithiasis and hypotrophy. Testicular cancer developed in three men (0.9%) over a median follow-up of 4.7 years. The authors conclude that biopsy should be considered in men with incidental microlithiasis only when testicular size is reduced, given the low subsequent cancer risk.

papers.title: Management of Advanced Germ Cell Tumours.
papers.title_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の管理
papers.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総説した。シスプラチン併用化学療法で高い治癒率が得られ、組織型、病変の広がり、国際分類に基づくリスクに応じて治療を調整する。非セミノーマでは化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除が重要である。多重再発・プラチナ抵抗性例に対する新規治療、減量戦略、生存者プログラムの必要性を強調している。
papers.summary_en: This review summarizes management of advanced germ cell tumors, which are highly curable with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Treatment is tailored to primary histology, disease spread and International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group risk. Bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin is the most common regimen, and post-chemotherapy residual mass resection is key for non-seminomas. Platinum-based conventional or high-dose chemotherapy can cure about half of patients who relapse after first-line treatment. The authors call for de-escalation strategies, survivorship programs and new treatments for multiply relapsed, platinum-resistant disease.

papers.title: Optimal Management of Stage II Seminoma: Preventing Harm While Preserving Cure.
papers.title_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマの最適な治療：害を防ぎつつ治癒を維持する
papers.summary_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマに対し、若年患者の毒性軽減を目指す新たな治療戦略（シスプラチン減量療法、化学放射線療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清）を評価した総説。小規模研究では有望だが長期成績は不足。標準治療の治癒率を損なわないことの重要性を強調。
papers.summary_en: This review examines emerging strategies for stage II testicular seminoma, aiming to reduce treatment toxicity in young patients without compromising cure. It discusses cisplatin-sparing chemotherapy, combined chemoradiotherapy, and primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Small studies report promising efficacy with minimal toxicity, but long-term follow-up is lacking. The authors argue that standard cisplatin-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy achieve excellent cure rates that should not be taken for granted, and they weigh each approach against both harm prevention and disease control.

papers.title: [ 68 Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT in Well-differentiated Ovarian Neuroendocrine Tumor Associated With Mature Cystic Teratoma.
papers.title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う高分化型卵巣神経内分泌腫瘍における[68Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT
papers.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う高分化型卵巣神経内分泌腫瘍の1例を報告した。[68Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET/CTで神経内分泌成分のソマトスタチン受容体発現を評価でき、奇形腫の形態評価と併せて有用であった。治療診断（セラノスティクス）への応用の可能性にも言及している。
papers.summary_en: This clinical nuclear medicine report describes a well-differentiated ovarian neuroendocrine tumor associated with a mature cystic teratoma in a single patient. Histologic diagnosis of such combined lesions is challenging because no defined guidelines exist. The authors show that [68Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT can evaluate somatostatin receptor expression of the neuroendocrine component while morphologic features assist in identifying the teratoma. They also note the potential for theranostic treatment approaches for these rare tumors.

papers.title: Primary Neuroendocrine Tumors of the Genitourinary System: Two Rare Examples of Testicular and Renal Neuroendocrine Tumors with Clinicopathologic and Molecular Findings.
papers.title_ja: 泌尿生殖器の原発性神経内分泌腫瘍:精巣および腎の神経内分泌腫瘍2例における臨床病理学的・分子学的所見
papers.summary_ja: 精巣と腎に生じた原発性泌尿生殖器神経内分泌腫瘍の2例を報告した症例報告。精巣NETは偶然発見され、当初は通常型の胚細胞腫瘍と考えられたが、低異型度のカルチノイド形態を示し、奇形腫や胚細胞内腫瘍は認められなかった。純粋な精巣NETは、12p等染色体を欠く単一胚葉性奇形腫として論じられている。
papers.summary_en: This report presents two patients with primary genitourinary neuroendocrine tumors, one testicular and one renal. The testicular NET was incidentally found and initially thought to be a conventional germ cell tumor, but showed pure low-grade carcinoid morphology without teratoma or germ cell neoplasia in situ. The authors discuss pure testicular NET as a prepubertal-type monodermal teratoma lacking isochromosome 12p. The renal NET metastasized to liver, lymph node and bone and carried an ERCC2 alteration, highlighting the need to recognize NETs at unusual sites.

papers.title: Fertility-sparing treatment in patients with placental trophoblastic site tumor: a systematic review.
papers.title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍患者における妊孕性温存治療：システマティックレビュー
papers.summary_ja: PSTT患者63例を対象に、妊孕性温存治療を扱った文献16編をシステマティックレビューで解析した。大半はFIGO病期I期であった。再発率は13.8%で、再発例はすべて子宮摘出術を受けた。全妊娠率は患者あたり36.5%であった。適切な症例では妊孕性温存治療が実行可能で安全と結論している。
papers.summary_en: This systematic review of PubMed, Scopus and Cochrane Library identified 16 articles covering 63 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor treated with fertility-sparing management. Most patients were FIGO stage I. The overall recurrence rate was 13.8%, and all recurrences were treated with hysterectomy. Among the cohort, 23 full-term pregnancies were reported, corresponding to a 36.5% fertility rate per patient. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing management is feasible and oncologically safe in selected patients with PSTT.

papers.title: Testis Molecular Pathways in CAIS Unveil Testosterone/Estradiol on Germ Cell Tumor Risk in Non-Obstructive Azoospermia.
papers.title_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症における精巣分子経路：非閉塞性無精子症における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクに対するテストステロン/エストラジオールの影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
papers.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症患者の精巣体細胞を単一細胞RNAシーケンス解析し、公開データと統合した。非遺伝性の非閉塞性無精子症で、セミノーマ微小環境関連遺伝子の発現が最も高かった。テストステロン/エストラジオール比の低下が胚細胞がんの予後と関連した。
papers.summary_en: This study performed single-cell RNA sequencing of testicular somatic cells from a patient with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome and integrated published datasets from normal testis, non-obstructive azoospermia, Klinefelter syndrome and germinal testicular cancer. Leydig cells were immature and senescent across conditions, and those in non-genetic non-obstructive azoospermia with primary hypogonadism showed the highest expression of seminoma-microenvironment and estrogen-responsive transcripts. In 343 testicular cancer patients and other cohorts, a decreasing testosterone-to-estradiol ratio carried prognostic value for germ cell cancer in non-genetic azoospermia. The authors suggest this ratio may guide aromatase inhibitor eligibility.

papers.title: Pediatric ovarian malignancies and outcomes in an urban tertiary care center.
papers.title_ja: 小児三次医療施設における小児卵巣悪性腫瘍とその転帰
papers.summary_ja: 小児三次施設で卵巣腫瘤に対し手術を受けた女性患者409例を後方視的に検討し、悪性または境界悪性31例(7.6%)を抽出。胚細胞腫瘍が最多(51.6%)で、未熟奇形腫が最も多かった。病期IまたはIIが大半で、術前腫瘍マーカーが未測定の例が21%あった。化学療法13例、再発4例、死亡7例。長期フォローアップと成人移行後の婦人科医の理解の重要性を指摘。
papers.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of female patients who underwent surgery for ovarian masses at a pediatric tertiary center identified 31 of 409 (7.6%) with malignant or borderline masses. Germ cell tumors were the most common histology (51.6%), with immature teratoma the most frequent subtype. Most patients presented at stage I or II, and 21% had no tumor markers drawn preoperatively. Thirteen received chemotherapy, four recurred, and seven died. The authors stress the need for long-term surveillance and for gynecologists to be familiar with these patients as they transition from pediatric care.

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of 68 Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT and 18 F-FDG-PET/CT in Primary Staging of Treatment-naïve Anterior Mediastinal Seminoma.
papers.title_ja: 治療歴のない前縦隔セミノーマの初期病期分類における68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CTと18F-FDG PET/CTの比較評価
papers.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値と生検で確定した前縦隔セミノーマの30歳男性の症例報告。治療前の初期病期分類として18F-FDG PET/CTと68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CTの両方を実施し、FAPIイメージングの有用性を検討した。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は縦隔腫瘍の1~4%を占める。
papers.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with elevated human chorionic gonadotropin and biopsy-proven seminoma of the anterior mediastinum. Before treatment, he underwent both 18F-FDG PET/CT and 68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT for primary staging, to examine whether FAPI imaging has a role in treatment-naive mediastinal seminoma. The report notes that germ cell tumors make up 1% to 4% of mediastinal tumors and that seminomas are less frequent than non-seminomatous tumors, providing the rationale for comparing these tracers in this rare setting.

papers.title: Rare and uncommon tumours of the female pelvis: what the radiologist should know.
papers.title_ja: 女性骨盤内の稀少腫瘍：放射線科医が知っておくべきこと
papers.summary_ja: 女性骨盤内の稀少腫瘍を放射線科医の視点から臓器別に解説した総説。卵巣では脂質に乏しい奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマを扱う。画像所見の理解を通じて治療計画への貢献を目指す。
papers.summary_en: This review addresses rare tumors of the female pelvis from a radiologist's perspective, organized by organ. Covered entities include uterine leiomyosarcoma, endometrial stromal sarcoma, carcinosarcoma, cervical gastric-type adenocarcinoma, and ovarian tumors such as lipid-poor teratoma, struma ovarii, immature teratoma and dysgerminoma. Lymphoma, neuroendocrine tumors, aggressive angiomyxoma and metastases occurring at multiple sites are also discussed. The authors aim to increase radiologists' familiarity with these uncommon entities so they can better inform treatment planning.

papers.title: A Rare Case of Retroperitoneal Teratoma Mimicking Paraganglioma on Multimodality Imaging.
papers.title_ja: 多モダリティ画像で傍神経節腫様を呈した後腹膜奇形腫の稀な症例
papers.summary_ja: 28歳女性の無症候性腹部腫瘤で、造影MRIとPET/CTから傍神経節腫が疑われた。しかし術後病理で甲状腺組織を含む奇形腫と確定した。甲状腺組織のソマトスタチン受容体発現が偽陽性の68Ga-DOTATATE集積の原因と考えられた。
papers.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with an incidentally found asymptomatic abdominal mass. Contrast-enhanced MRI showed a retroperitoneal lesion with arterial hyperenhancement and washout, suggesting paraganglioma. 18F-FDG PET/CT showed mild, heterogeneous uptake, while 68Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT showed intense uptake, further supporting that diagnosis. Postoperative pathology, however, confirmed a teratoma containing thyroid tissue that expressed somatostatin receptor subtypes 2 and 5. This ectopic thyroid tissue likely explained the false-positive 68Ga-DOTATATE uptake. The report highlights this pitfall when evaluating retroperitoneal masses with high somatostatin receptor tracer uptake.

papers.title: Expression of ENPP1 in Testicular Germ Cell Tumors: Exploring Its Role in the Pathobiology of Distinct Histotypes and in Prognosis.
papers.title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるENPP1発現：組織型別の病態生物学と予後
papers.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍63例の90腫瘍成分でENPP1の免疫組織化学染色を行った研究です。胎児性癌で発現が最も高く、セミノーマも他の組織型より高値でした。転移巣は原発巣より低値でした。正常精巣の胚細胞では発現がなく、ENPP1阻害薬による標的治療の可能性が示唆されています。
papers.summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of ENPP1 expression in 90 tumor components from 63 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, with comparison to normal testis and in silico TCGA and Human Protein Atlas analyses. ENPP1 was highest in embryonal carcinoma and significantly higher in seminoma than in other subtypes, and was lower in metastatic than in primary tumors. It was absent in normal testicular germ cells. The authors suggest that TGCTs, especially embryonal carcinoma, may respond to ENPP1 inhibitors, with low fertility-related toxicity risk.

papers.title: The absence of FOXA2 and HNF1β expression in vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions of germ cell origin suggests an evolutionary pathway similar to that of sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor.
papers.title_ja: 胚細胞起源の血管形成性間葉系病変におけるFOXA2およびHNF1β発現の欠如は、肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍と類似の進化経路を示唆する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
papers.summary_ja: 化学療法後に生じる血管形成性間葉系病変（VML）のFOXA2とHNF1β発現を免疫組織化学で検討した基礎研究。VMLでは発現が乏しく、卵黄嚢腫瘍から間葉系表現型への転換の機序が示唆された。
papers.summary_en: This laboratory study examined FOXA2 and HNF1β expression in vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions (VMLs), rare germ cell tumor-derived phenotypes that typically arise after chemotherapy for mediastinal yolk sac tumor. VMLs lacked significant FOXA2 and HNF1β expression, unlike conventional yolk sac tumors, which express them strongly. The findings suggest that combined downregulation of these transcription factors may underlie the transformation of yolk sac tumor into mesenchymal phenotypes, resembling the pathway of sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor, although the factors that determine the final phenotype remain unclear.

papers.title: Cystic Teratoma with Neuroectodermal Cyst and Choroid Plexus Like Epithelium, A Rare Entity in the Head and Neck: Case Report with Literature Review.
papers.title_ja: 神経外胚葉嚢胞と脈絡叢様上皮を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫：頭頸部における稀な病態、症例報告と文献レビュー
papers.summary_ja: 2歳男児の左頬部(咬筋間隙)に4.6cm大の無痛性腫脹があり、頭蓋内病変は認められなかった。組織学的に脈絡叢様の乳頭状増殖を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫で、神経外胚葉成分を免疫染色で確認した。頬部での初報告である。
papers.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a slowly growing left facial swelling in the masseteric space measuring 4.6 × 3.6 × 3.7 cm, with no intracranial involvement. Histology showed cystic cavities lined by flat cells with focal choroid plexus-like papillary proliferations and a capsule of glial fibrillary material, without dermoid, epidermoid, bone or cartilage. Immunohistochemistry for GFAP, keratin, vimentin and S100 confirmed neuroectodermal components. The final diagnosis was cystic teratoma with neuroectodermal cyst, which the authors describe as the first such case in the cheek.

papers.title: Successful Perinatal Management of a Large Fetal Intrapericardial Teratoma by Serial Fetal Echocardiogram and ex utero Intrapartum Treatment.
papers.title_ja: 胎児の巨大心膜内奇形腫に対する連続胎児心エコーとEXIT下分娩中切除による周産期管理の成功例
papers.summary_ja: 妊娠20週で診断された巨大な胎児心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。胎児心エコーと超音波検査で経過を追跡した。急速な胎児水腫と母体のミラー症候群を契機に、EXIT手技で胎盤循環下に奇形腫を完全切除し、母児ともに良好な転帰を得た。連続的な胎児心エコーが重要な出生前ツールであり、EXIT下の切除は安全な選択肢と結論づけている。
papers.summary_en: This case report describes a large fetal intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed at 20 weeks' gestation and followed with serial fetal echocardiography and ultrasound. Sudden progression to fetal hydrops with maternal mirror syndrome prompted delivery by ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) to resection, during which the teratoma was completely removed while on placental-fetal circulation. Both mother and baby had successful outcomes. The authors conclude that serial fetal echocardiography is a key prenatal tool, and EXIT-to-resection is a safe option for large pericardial teratomas.

papers.title: Mediastinal Teratoma With Somatic-Type Adenocarcinoma: An Enigmatic Discovery by Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology.
papers.title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫に体細胞型腺癌を伴う症例：穿刺細胞診による予期せぬ発見
papers.summary_ja: 35歳男性の前縦隔腫瘤(9.2cm)による縦隔圧迫例で、超音波ガイド下穿刺細胞診により体細胞型腺癌が奇形腫に伴うと示唆された。切除標本の病理組織学的検査で確定した。良性腸上皮成分が奇形腫起源を強く示した。
papers.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with mediastinal compression from a 9.2 cm heterogeneous anterior mediastinal mass. Ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration cytology showed malignant epithelial clusters with mucin and benign intestinal epithelial cells, suggesting somatic-type adenocarcinoma arising in a teratoma. Histopathology of the excised mass confirmed the cytological diagnosis. The authors note that the benign intestinal component strongly favored a teratomatous origin over primary aerodigestive or metastatic adenocarcinoma. They conclude that imaging-guided cytology is a minimally invasive and effective tool for early diagnosis in acute mediastinal obstruction.

papers.title: Immunohistochemical expression of Nectin-4 and potential implications for enfortumab vedotin therapy in germ cell tumors of the testis: a preliminary study.
papers.title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるNectin-4免疫組織化学的発現とエンホルツマブ・ベドチン療法への示唆：予備的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
papers.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍46例でNectin-4の免疫組織化学染色を行った予備的研究です。膜発現は全体の15.7%に限られましたが、絨毛癌と孤立性合胞栄養細胞では有意に高値でした。化学療法後の転移性再発例にも陽性例がありました。絨毛癌や再発例がエンホルツマブ・ベドチンの適応候補となりうると示唆されています。
papers.summary_en: A preliminary immunohistochemical study of Nectin-4 expression in 46 testicular germ cell tumor cases, mostly chemo-naive primary tumors plus four post-chemotherapy metastatic recurrences. Membrane Nectin-4 was positive in only 15.7% of components, but choriocarcinoma and isolated syncytiotrophoblast cells showed significantly higher expression than other components. Two of four post-chemotherapy recurrences and three embryonal carcinomas showed weak membrane positivity. The authors suggest aggressive subtypes, especially choriocarcinoma and post-chemotherapy recurrences, may be candidates for enfortumab vedotin, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4.
